digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter - Cloud summary write and primary-store observation
propositions: One Cloud summary write invocation launches exactly one acli jira workitem edit subprocess with proper POSIX process-group and child cleanup.
Summary recovery performs one primary-store REST request via get_issue_by_rest with one-attempt/no-sleep policy, consuming only per-call logical budget without affecting unrelated callers.
All existing consumers of _direct_rest_get and get_issue_by_rest outside summary recovery retain three-attempt/2s-5s retry default without signature or behavior changes.
Permanent outcomes (auth, TLS, permission, invalid) are classified without adapter replay; transient outcomes (network, 429, retryable 5xx) return metadata to shared budget.

Every terminal or exhausted outcome emits exactly one completion log containing logical id, disposition, invocation/request counts, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and one redacted message capped at 512 code points (whole log at most 1,024 code points).
Operation diagnostics collection holds at most eight entries with every message redacted before per-message 512-Unicode-code-point cap.
